scope_items.label: Demolition
scope_items.description: Remove and dispose of existing bathroom finishes and fixtures. Furnish (1) 30-yard container for debris removal.

scope_items.label: Framing
scope_items.description: Furnish and install framing as required to support new construction.

scope_items.label: Drywall
scope_items.description: Furnish and install 1/2" moisture-resistant (green board) drywall, Level 3 finish, approximately 1,840 sq ft.

scope_items.label: Painting
scope_items.description: Prepare and paint all new drywall surfaces, approximately 1,840 sq ft.

scope_items.label: Plumbing
scope_items.description: Furnish and install rough-in and supply/install of the following fixtures: (6) sinks, (5) toilets, (5) showers, (5) shower drains.

scope_items.label: Tile
scope_items.description: Furnish and install wall tile (288 sf), floor tile (226 sf), and chair rail tile (410 sf). Furnish and install wall waterproofing (288 sf). Furnish and install (5) shower pan mud jobs with waterproofing.

scope_items.label: Countertops
scope_items.description: Furnish and install countertops, approximately 36 sq ft.

scope_items.label: Finish Carpentry
scope_items.description: Furnish and install finish carpentry as required.

scope_items.label: Protection
scope_items.description: Provide protection of existing surfaces and adjacent areas during construction.

clarifications: Pricing is valid for thirty (30) days.
All work will be done in a professional and workmanlike manner, licensed as required by law.
All work to be fully covered with compensation and liability insurances.
Tax is not included. It is assumed that a capital improvement certificate will be provided prior to the start of construction.
Excludes drilling for plumbing or modifying any existing plumbing lines. Scope is limited to fixture-level rough-in and supply/install of the fixtures listed above.
tax_label: Sales Tax (NY — excluded, capital improvement certificate assumed)
